units.en: When Chang took the throne, Tuo became Commissioner of the Playful Splendor Palace and Superintendent of the Palace Domestic Service, while also overseeing the Liesheng and Jingyang ancestral palaces.
units.literal: When Chang established himself on the throne, Tuo was changed to Commissioner of the Playful Splendor Palace and Superintendent of the Palace Domestic Service, together with Commissioner of the Two Ancestor Palaces of Liesheng and Jingyang.

units.zh: 托納二女於鋹，鋹以其長為貴妃，次為美人，政事皆訪托而後行。
units.en: Tuo gave two daughters to Chang in marriage; the elder became Honored Consort and the younger a Beauty. No policy moved forward until Tuo had been consulted.
units.literal: Tuo presented two daughters to Chang; Chang made the elder Honored Consort and the younger a Beauty, and all government affairs were consulted with Tuo before being carried out.

units.zh: 加特進、開府儀同三司、甘泉宮使兼六軍觀軍容使、行內中尉，遷驃騎上將軍、內太師。
units.en: He received Special Advancement, Grandee Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Commissioner of the Sweet Spring Palace, Army Observer of the Six Armies, and Acting Inner Captain, then rose to Cavalry Grand General and Inner Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: He was given the special advancement of Grand Mentor, Grandee Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Commissioner of the Sweet Spring Palace together with Army Observer of the Six Armies, and Acting Inner Captain; he was then promoted to Cavalry Grand General and Inner Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 太祖命師伐鋹，既克韶州，統軍使李承渥戰死，節度副使辛延渥間道遣人勸鋹降，托堅沮其議。
units.en: When Taizu sent his army against Chang and Shao Prefecture fell, army commander Li Chenwo was killed in battle. Deputy commissioner Xin Yanwo sent an envoy by a secret route to urge surrender, but Tuo firmly blocked the proposal.
units.literal: Taizu ordered an army to attack Chang; after Shao Prefecture was taken, army commander Li Chenwo died in battle, and deputy commissioner Xin Yanwo sent a man by a hidden route to urge Chang to surrender — Tuo firmly blocked the deliberation.

units.zh: 及就擒至許田，太祖遣使問托等：「昨已約降，復率眾來拒戰，及軍敗又縱火焚府庫，誰為之謀也？」
units.en: After their capture and arrival at Xutian, Taizu sent an envoy to question Tuo and his associates: "You had already agreed to surrender, yet you rallied troops to fight again, and when defeated you set fire to the storehouses. Who planned this?"
units.literal: When they were captured and brought to Xutian, Taizu dispatched an envoy to question Tuo and the others: "Yesterday you had agreed to surrender, yet again led the masses to resist in battle; when the army was defeated you again set fire and burned the storehouses — who devised this?"

units.zh: 托俯首不能對。
units.en: Tuo hung his head and had no answer.
units.literal: Tuo bowed his head and could not reply.

units.zh: 鋹諫議大夫王珪謂托曰：「昔在廣州，機務並爾輩所專，火又自內起，今天子遣使案問，爾復欲推過何人？」
units.en: Chang's Remonstrating Censor Wang Gui said to Tuo, "In Guangzhou you and your faction controlled every decision; the fire was lit from within the palace. Now the Son of Heaven sends an envoy to investigate — who else do you mean to blame?"
units.literal: Chang's Remonstrating Censor Wang Gui said to Tuo: "Formerly in Guangzhou, state affairs were all monopolized by you lot; the fire also started from within. Today the Son of Heaven has sent an envoy to investigate — to whom do you again wish to shift the blame?"

units.zh: 遂唾而批其頰，托乃引伏，後至京斬之。
units.en: He spat in Tuo's face and struck his cheek. Tuo confessed on the spot and was later executed when they reached the capital.
units.literal: Thereupon he spat and struck his cheek; Tuo then confessed, and later, upon reaching the capital, was executed.

units.zh: 薛崇譽，韶州曲江人。
units.en: Xue Chongyu came from Qujiang in Shao Prefecture.
units.literal: Xue Chongyu was a native of Qujiang in Shao Prefecture.

units.zh: 善《孫子五曹算》。
units.en: He was versed in Sunzi's Five Methods of Calculation.
units.literal: He was skilled in Sunzi's Five Methods of Calculation.

units.zh: 晟署為內門使兼太倉使。
units.en: Shen appointed him Inner Gate Commissioner and Grand Granary Commissioner.
units.literal: Shen appointed him Inner Gate Commissioner together with Grand Granary Commissioner.

units.zh: 鋹嗣位，遷內中尉、特進、開府儀同三司、簽書點檢司事。
units.en: When Chang took the throne, Chongyu became Inner Captain, received Special Advancement and Grandee Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and was appointed Secretary of Inspection Bureau Affairs.
units.literal: When Chang succeeded to the throne, Chongyu was promoted to Inner Captain, given special advancement as Grand Mentor and Grandee Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and made Secretary of Inspection Bureau Affairs.

units.zh: 太祖命師克廣州，崇譽縱火焚倉廩，擒至京，與李托同戮。
units.en: When Taizu's army took Guangzhou, Chongyu set fire to the granaries. Captured and brought to the capital, he was executed alongside Li Tuo.
units.literal: When Taizu ordered the army to capture Guangzhou, Chongyu set fire and burned the granaries; captured and brought to the capital, he was executed together with Li Tuo.

units.zh: 潘崇徹，廣州南海人。
units.en: Pan Chongche came from Nanhai in Guangzhou.
units.literal: Pan Chongche was a native of Nanhai in Guangzhou.

units.zh: 事龑為內侍省局丞。
units.en: He entered service under the emperor with the invented name as a Bureau Assistant in the Palace Domestic Service.
units.literal: He served the emperor with the invented name as Bureau Assistant in the Palace Domestic Service.

units.zh: 頗讀兵書，立戰功。
units.en: He studied military texts and won distinction in battle.
units.literal: He read military books extensively and established battle merit.

units.zh: 晟嘗遣大將吳懷恩伐桂州平之，懷恩為部下所殺，命崇徹代之。
units.en: Shen once sent the general Wu Huai'en to conquer Gui Prefecture. When Wu was killed by his own men, Shen put Chongche in command.
units.literal: Shen once dispatched the great general Wu Huai'en to attack Gui Prefecture and pacify it; Huai'en was killed by his subordinates, and Shen ordered Chongche to replace him.

units.zh: 鋹襲位，加西北面都統。
units.en: When Chang took the throne, Chongche was made Commander-in-Chief of the Northwest Area.
units.literal: When Chang succeeded to the throne, Chongche was additionally made Commander-in-Chief of the Northwest Area.

units.zh: 歲餘，鋹頗疑崇徹，遣薛宗譽使其軍以察之。
units.en: After a year Chang grew suspicious of Chongche and sent Xue Chongyu to his camp to investigate.
units.literal: After more than a year Chang grew quite suspicious of Chongche and dispatched Xue Chongyu to his army to inspect him.

units.zh: 崇譽還，遂白崇徹日以伶人百餘衣錦繡、吹玉笛，為長夜之飲，不恤軍政。
units.en: On his return Chongyu reported that Chongche spent his days with more than a hundred performers in brocade robes, playing jade flutes and feasting through the night while neglecting military affairs.
units.literal: Chongyu returned and reported that Chongche daily had more than a hundred actors clad in brocade, blowing jade flutes, holding all-night drinking revels, and not caring for military government.

units.zh: 鋹怒，召歸，奪其兵柄，自是居常怏怏。
units.en: Enraged, Chang recalled him and stripped him of command. Thereafter Chongche lived in perpetual resentment.
units.literal: Chang was angry, summoned him back, and stripped him of military authority; from then on he lived in constant discontent.

units.zh: 太祖命師度嶺，鋹復命崇徹領兵五萬戍賀江，崇徹不為效命。
units.en: When Taizu's army crossed the mountains, Chang again put Chongche in charge of fifty thousand troops to guard the He River, but Chongche refused to fight with any zeal.
units.literal: When Taizu ordered the army to cross the mountains, Chang again ordered Chongche to lead fifty thousand troops to garrison the He River; Chongche did not exert himself in service.

units.zh: 鋹敗，至京，太祖知其事，特赦之，授汝州別駕，卒。
units.en: After Chang's defeat Chongche was brought to the capital. Taizu, knowing what had transpired, granted him a special pardon and appointed him Vice-Governor of Ru Prefecture, where he later died.
units.literal: When Chang was defeated and reached the capital, Taizu knew the circumstances, specially pardoned him, appointed him Vice-Governor of Ru Prefecture, and he died.
